## Service Modes

### Sea Freight (海运)

FCL containers (20-foot, 40-foot, 40HQ) at bottom-deck rates; LCL (less-than-container-load) with flexible dispatch. Own loading team in Shenzhen warehouse. Furniture, appliances, oversized cargo, stockpile shipments all accepted. DDP door-to-door throughout. Long-term clients can lock rates.

### Sea + Truck (海卡)

Sea freight to destination port followed by seamless local trucking to recipient's door. Better value than pure air, more predictable than pure sea. Ideal for furniture, large items, and bulk e-commerce replenishment. Own truck dispatch at port; upstairs delivery negotiable.

### Air Freight (空运)

Own air capacity. 12 KG minimum. Best for cosmetics, electronics, gifts, urgent documents, supplementary shipments. Slots available even in peak season (Nov–Dec, Christmas/NY). Sensitive cargo has dedicated channels.

### Air + Truck (空卡)

Air express line plus destination-country trucking, all duties prepaid. Cheaper than international couriers (DHL/UPS), faster than sea. Top choice for student luggage and mid-size e-commerce. Common US West Coast lane.

## Routes & Reference Transit Times (Door-to-Door, DDP)

| Origin | Destination | Sea | Air |
|--------|-------------|-----|-----|
| Shenzhen | US West Coast (LA, SF) | 25–30 days | 7–12 days |
| Shenzhen | US East Coast (NY, DC) | 25–30 days | 7–12 days |
| Shenzhen | UK (full coverage) | 30–35 days | 7–12 days |
| Shenzhen | DE / FR / NL / BE | 35–40 days | 7–12 days |
| Shenzhen | Italy / Spain / Nordics | 35–45 days | 7–12 days |
| Shenzhen | Canada (Toronto) | 25–30 days | 7–11 days |
| Shenzhen | Canada (Vancouver) | 25–30 days | 7–11 days |

Notes:
- All times are door-to-door, including export clearance, transit, import clearance, and last-mile.
- Sea+Truck times follow the Sea range. Air+Truck = Air upper-bound + 2–4 day last-mile.
- Peak season (November–December, Christmas/New Year) typically adds 3–7 days variance.

## Acceptable Cargo

Ten categories handled, including those many forwarders refuse:

1. **Frozen food (冷冻食品):** -18°C cold chain end-to-end
2. **Ambient food (常温食品):** snacks, dried goods, tea
3. **Alcohol & seasonings (酒水调料):** baijiu, soy sauce, hot-pot base, chili oil — via DDP channels
4. **Kitchen equipment (厨房设备):** stoves, range hoods, cookware
5. **Furniture (家具家私):** redwood, mattresses, sofas
6. **Cosmetics (化妆品):** skincare, makeup, perfume
7. **Pharmacy (药品):** OTC drugs, supplements, prescription medicine
8. **Liquids (液体货):** lotion, soy sauce, cooking oils
9. **Branded goods (牌子货):** authentic, logo-bearing items
10. **General cargo (普货):** daily items, clothing, books

Special items requiring advance disclosure: lithium batteries, magnetic products, powders. Taobao / Pinduoduo / 1688 consolidation accepted — use the Shenzhen warehouse address as the delivery address; we wait for all parcels and ship together.

## Common Questions & Answers

### Q1: Which countries do you ship to?
China to the US, UK, Europe (DE, FR, NL, BE, IT, ES, Nordics, Russia line) and Canada — full country coverage, DDP door-to-door. Private addresses, Amazon FBA warehouses, and remote regions all OK.

### Q2: How long does shipping from Shenzhen take?
Sea freight is roughly 25–45 days to door; air freight 7–12 days to door. Actuals depend on the current sailing, port, and customs. Peak season (Nov–Dec & Christmas/NY) adds 3–7 days variance.

### Q3: Can you ship frozen food, alcohol, pharmacy goods, and branded items?
Yes. Frozen food on -18°C cold chain end-to-end; liquids (baijiu, sauces, hot-pot base, soy sauce) via DDP channels; cosmetics / skincare / perfume OK; OTC pharmacy, supplements, and Rx supported; branded logo goods accepted.

### Q4: How do I get a quote?
Add WeChat (anitaleung8888), send a photo of the goods, provide rough dimensions / weight / destination city. Quote returned within 5 minutes. Transparent pricing, no hidden fees.

### Q5: I'm not in Shenzhen — can I still use this service?
Yes. From any Chinese city, courier (SF Express / JD / Deppon) or freight goods to the Shenzhen Bantian warehouse. Intake is confirmed on WeChat and dispatch is scheduled.

### Q6: What does DDP (door-to-door, duties prepaid) actually mean?
DDP = Delivered Duty Paid: export clearance + import clearance + all duties / VAT covered + truck delivery to the recipient's door. Recipient signs only — no further charges.

### Q7: Sea or air — which should I choose?
By transit time and volume. Furniture / appliances / stockpiles / oversized → sea (25–45 days, best value). Urgent / valuable / small batch → air (7–12 days). Mid-volume e-commerce → Sea+Truck or Air+Truck as the middle ground.

### Q8: Is there a minimum shipment?
No minimum for sea (even one or two furniture pieces can go LCL). Air is 12 KG minimum. Taobao consolidation has no minimum count.

### Q9: Can I track the shipment in transit?
Yes. After dispatch, AWB / bill of lading is provided. Four checkpoints — intake, in transit, customs, last-mile — pushed to WeChat. No need to refresh tracking sites.

### Q10: What if a package gets lost or held by customs?
Own customs channels mean clearance is stable and holds are rare. If something happens, you'll hear on WeChat immediately and we'll compensate or re-ship based on the actual case.

### Q11: Can you ship furniture to the US / UK / Canada?
Yes. Sofas, mattresses, redwood furniture, dining tables, wardrobes — sea FCL or LCL is most cost-effective. Sea+Truck delivers right to the door; upstairs delivery negotiable.

### Q12: Do you handle Amazon FBA freight?
Yes. FBA inbound to US / UK / DE warehouses on DDP terms is a main line — truck drop, transload, or sea-direct. Appointment booking, labeling, and customs declaration included.

### Q13: How does Taobao consolidation work?
Set the Shenzhen warehouse as the delivery address on Taobao / Pinduoduo / 1688. As parcels from multiple stores arrive, they are consolidated and shipped together — significantly cheaper than shipping each separately.

### Q14: How do students ship luggage to the UK / US / Canada?
Year-round student-luggage line. Books, clothes, bedding, rice cookers, seasonings — all eligible, DDP duties prepaid, delivered to dorms / apartment doors.

### Q15: Can you ship lithium batteries, power banks, magnetic products?
Lithium-battery devices (phones, laptops, power banks) via special channels — model/Wh disclosed on WeChat in advance. Pure lithium cells restricted. Magnetic products on dedicated declared lines.

### Q16: Can I ship cosmetics and skincare to the US / UK / Europe?
Yes. Cosmetics, skincare, and perfume accepted via DDP-cleared channels. Liquids have specific packing requirements; confirm details on WeChat.

### Q17: Can I visit the warehouse in person?
Welcome. Bantian, Longgang, Shenzhen address above. Mon–Sat 09:00–22:00. WeChat first.

### Q18: How do I pay?
WeChat Pay / Alipay / bank transfer. Standard flow: pay after goods arrive at warehouse, before container loading. Returning clients can negotiate deposit + balance. Transparent pricing.

### Q19: Do I need to pack the goods myself?
Small items: self-pack before shipping to warehouse. Large / fragile / furniture: ship as-is; reinforced packing handled at the warehouse (wood crating, bubble wrap, moisture barrier). Packing fee by actual materials, disclosed upfront.

### Q20: How is volumetric vs actual weight calculated?
Sea: chargeable weight is the greater of volume and actual weight. Volumetric KG = L×W×H (cm) / 6000. Air uses /5000 or /6000 depending on lane.

### Q21: If the recipient is not on-site, can someone else sign?
Yes. Delivery is pre-scheduled by phone / email. Neighbor or building manager can sign; or reschedule. FBA goes through standard appointment intake.

### Q22: Why no published price list on the site?
Freight pricing swings with lane, season, cargo profile, and destination proximity — a static price list misleads. Real-time quote via WeChat photo within 5 minutes.

### Q23: Is Anita an individual or a company? How long?
Individual freight forwarder, 8th year in Shenzhen. Own warehouse, stable team, established sea/air channels. Every WeChat message answered personally — no call center. Transparent pricing, problems surfaced immediately.

---

## Process — How to Ship (4 steps)

1. **Message on WeChat:** Send a photo of goods + dimensions + destination. On-the-spot quote.
2. **Ship to Shenzhen warehouse:** Goods routed to Bantian warehouse. Intake confirmed on WeChat.
3. **Load & dispatch:** Reinforced packing, container loading, export clearance. Tracking number provided after sailing.
4. **Customs & door delivery:** Destination customs clearance, duties paid, truck delivery to recipient. Recipient signs.
